Name: Guarding Bond
Description: While active, your beast gains +20% Defense, +20% Force Defense, takes 15% less damage, and generates +75% enmity. Only one stance may be active at a time.

Name: Predatory Bond
Description: While active, your beast deals +25% damage, gains +15% haste and +10% ability accuracy, and generates 40% less enmity. Only one stance may be active at a time.

Name: Revive Beast
Description: Revives your pet with (45 + SOC)% HP.

Name: Reward
Description: Restores 130 HP plus 20% of your pet's max HP, increased by 1% per SOC. Consumes a treat item on use.

Name: Soothe Pet
Description: Removes debuffs from your pet.

Name: Tame
Description: Enables you to tame & train creatures between levels 0 and 50. Taming chance increases by 3% per SOC, capped at 75%.

Name: Adhesive Grenade
Description: Slows enemies in a 4m blast for 12 seconds. Affects up to 5 targets. Consumes explosives.

Name: Arc Projector
Description: Projects an overcharged electrical arc up to 15m, dealing 60 electrical DMG plus PER scaling to one target.

Name: Blaster Beacon
Description: Plants a visible 14m targeting sphere for 30 seconds. Every 3 seconds, one hostile target inside is hit by an automated ranged energy pulse for 10 physical DMG plus PER scaling.

Name: Cluster Grenade
Description: Throws three adjacent grenades within 3m of the target point. Each grenade deals 18 fire DMG plus PER scaling in a 2m blast, and overlapping blasts can hit the same enemy. Consumes explosives.

Name: Concussion Grenade
Description: Deals 28 electrical DMG plus PER scaling in a 3m blast and knocks down for 3 seconds. Affects up to 5 targets. Consumes explosives.

Name: Cryo Sprayer
Description: Deals 25 ice DMG plus PER scaling to hostile targets in a 6m x 5m cone and slows their movement for 30 seconds.

Name: Deflector Shield
Description: Grants one ally 100 temporary HP plus 12% of the target's maximum HP for 45 seconds.

Name: Disruption Pulse
Description: Emits a 5m disruption pulse at a target point within 12m, dealing 18 electrical DMG plus PER scaling to enemies and reducing physical and Force ability Accuracy by 6% for 12 seconds. Consumes explosives.

Name: Emergency Bunker
Description: Deploys an 8m-radius shield bunker at the target location for 45 seconds. Allies inside gain 60 temporary HP plus 8% of each target's maximum HP and take 15% less physical and Force damage.

Name: Flamethrower
Description: Deals 42 fire DMG plus PER scaling to hostile targets in a 6m x 5m cone and attempts to inflict Burn for 12 seconds.

Name: Flash Grenade
Description: Attempts to inflict Flash, reducing physical and Force ability hit chance by 8% for 30 seconds in a 4m blast. Affects up to 5 targets. Consumes explosives.

Name: Frag Grenade
Description: Deals 48 fire DMG plus PER scaling to enemies in a 3m blast and attempts to inflict Bleed for 12 seconds. Consumes explosives.

Name: Group Deflector
Description: Allies within 5m gain 70 temporary HP plus 8% of each target's maximum HP for 30 seconds.

Name: Incendiary Field
Description: Deploys a visible 5m-radius fire field at the target location for 30 seconds. Enemies inside take 16 fire DMG plus PER scaling every 3 seconds.

Name: Ion Grenade
Description: Deals 34 electrical DMG plus PER scaling in a 3m blast. Deals 60% bonus damage to droids and inflicts Shock for 12 seconds. Consumes explosives.

Name: Ion Lance
Description: Fires a focused ion beam from a wrist projector in an 8m x 2.5m line, dealing 44 electrical DMG plus PER scaling to hostile targets in the line.

Name: Killzone Beacon
Description: Plants a visible 12m killzone sphere for 45 seconds. Every 3 seconds, all hostile targets inside are hit by one 16 physical DMG plus PER scaling pulse and one 16 electrical DMG plus PER scaling shock pulse.

Name: Overload Barrage
Description: Unleashes three attacks at your primary target's location: a 42 fire DMG 5m burst plus Burn for 45 seconds, a 48 fire DMG single-target hit plus 3-second Knockdown, and a 24 sonic DMG 5m burst that interrupts activation and reduces Accuracy by 10% for 45 seconds.

Name: Power Cell
Description: Restores 18% of maximum STM to the selected ally and allies within 5m and increases physical and Force ability Accuracy by 6% for 30 seconds.

Name: Rail Dart
Description: Fires a dart that deals 48 physical DMG plus PER scaling and attempts to inflict Bleed for 12 seconds.

Name: Remote Charge
Description: Arms a visible charge at your target location that detonates after 3 seconds in a 5m-radius blast for 42 fire DMG plus PER scaling and inflicts Knockdown for 6 seconds.

Name: Shock Beacon
Description: Plants a visible 5m shock sphere for 30 seconds. Every 3 seconds, one hostile target inside is hit for 14 electrical DMG plus PER scaling and suffers Shock.

Name: Signal Jammer
Description: Deploys a signal jammer for 45 seconds. Hostile targets within 5m suffer -6% physical and Force ability Accuracy and cannot benefit from Haste while inside.

Name: Sonic Burst
Description: Deals 18 sonic DMG to hostile targets within 5m, interrupts activation, and reduces Accuracy by 10% for 30 seconds.

Name: Thermal Detonator
Description: Deals 60 fire DMG plus PER scaling in a 5m blast and inflicts Burn for 45 seconds. Consumes explosives.

Name: Weapon Jam
Description: Reduce one target's physical and Force ability Accuracy by 6% for 18 seconds.

Name: Wrist Rocket
Description: Deals 48 fire DMG plus PER scaling to one target and knocks down for 3 seconds.

Name: Ghost Protocol
Description: Reduces your enmity by 80%, enters stealth for up to 30 seconds, and causes your next back attack within 30 seconds to critically hit and inflict Exposed, reducing Defense by 20% for 30 seconds.

Name: Razor Trap
Description: Places a visible trap that arms after 3 seconds. When triggered, enemies within its 3m blast take 30 physical DMG plus PER scaling and Bleed for 30 seconds.

Name: Shadow Step
Description: Dash behind one hostile target within 5m, remove negative movement-speed effects, and increase Evasion by 15% for 30 seconds.

Name: Shock Trap
Description: Places a visible trap that arms after 3 seconds. When triggered, enemies within its 3m blast take 22 electrical DMG plus PER scaling and suffer Shock for 30 seconds.

Name: Stealth
Reuse: Use native action mode; no extra custom clip required
Description: Enter stealth, increasing Stealth by 20 while active. Drains 2 STM every 6 seconds, breaks on hostile action, and can only be entered while out of combat.

Name: Tactical Escape
Description: Reduces your enmity by 60%, removes negative movement-speed effects, and increases Evasion by 12% for 30 seconds.

Name: Adrenal Stim
Description: Restores 25% of maximum STM and restores 1 STM every 3 seconds for 30 seconds. Consumes a stim pack.

Name: Antitoxin
Description: Grants 50% Poison Resistance for 2 minutes and removes one Poison or Toxin effect. Poison Resistance also weakens Disease and Toxin effects. Consumes a stim pack.

Name: Emergency Cocktail
Description: Restores 25% of maximum STM, removes one Poison or Toxin effect, then for 45 seconds restores 1 STM every 3 seconds, grants temporary HP equal to 12% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling, reduces damage taken by 12%, and grants 50% Poison Resistance.

Name: Emergency Triage
Description: Restores 18% of the target's maximum HP plus WIL scaling instantly. Can target allies up to 15m away. Healing is doubled if the target is below 35% HP. Consumes extra medical supplies.

Name: Focus Stim
Description: Increases physical and Force ability Accuracy by 8% for 2 minutes. Consumes a stim pack.

Name: Infusion
Description: Grants a single target regeneration, healing 5% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling every 3 seconds for 30 seconds. Consumes medical supplies.

Name: Kolto Mist
Description: Deploys a 30-second healing mist cloud at a target location up to 15m away. Allies within 8m heal for 2% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling every 3 seconds. Consumes medical supplies.

Name: Med Kit
Description: Restores 36% of the target's maximum HP plus WIL scaling to a single target. Consumes medical supplies.

Name: Pain Suppressant
Description: Grants temporary HP equal to 15% of the target's maximum HP plus WIL scaling and 15% damage reduction for 30 seconds. Consumes a stim pack.

Name: Resuscitation
Description: Revives an unconscious target with 20% HP plus WIL scaling. Consumes medical supplies.

Name: Shielding
Description: Reduces physical and force damage taken by 11% for 3 minutes. Consumes a stim pack.

Name: Treatment Kit
Description: Removes Bleed, Poison, Toxin, Burn, Shock, and Disease from a single target and grants 50% Fire Resistance, 50% Poison Resistance, 50% Electrical Resistance, 50% Ice Resistance, and 50% Trauma Resistance for 30 seconds.

Name: Benevolence
Description: Restores 20% of the target's maximum HP plus WIL scaling to a single target. Healing gains +25% when targeting someone other than yourself.

Name: Creeping Terror
Description: Creates a visible 8m field within 15m for 30 seconds. Enemies inside are Hobbled and take 18 force DMG plus WIL scaling every 3 seconds.

Name: Eclipse of Resolve
Description: Enemies within 5m suffer -12% physical and Force ability Accuracy, -12% Evasion, and +20% FP and STM costs for 30 seconds.

Name: Force Burst
Description: Deals 44 force DMG plus WIL scaling to the selected target and enemies within 5m.

Name: Force Choke
Description: Immobilizes one target for 30 seconds, interrupts activation, and deals 34 force DMG plus WIL scaling over the duration.

Name: Force Drain
Description: Deals 36 force DMG plus WIL scaling to one target and heals you for 40% of damage dealt. If the target is below 50% HP, healing increases to 50%.

Name: Force Intercept
Description: Leap to an ally up to 15m away and absorb 50% of the next hit they take within 30 seconds.

Name: Force Judgment
Description: Deals 48 force DMG plus WIL scaling to the selected target and enemies within 5m, reducing outgoing weapon and force damage by 8% for 30 seconds.

Name: Force Leap
Description: Leap to a hostile target up to 18m away, dealing 18 force DMG plus WIL scaling and interrupting activation.

Name: Force Lightning
Description: Deals 40 force DMG plus WIL scaling to one target, then arcs to up to three enemies within 5m for 50% damage. Affected targets suffer Shock for 30 seconds.

Name: Force Push
Description: Deals 18 force DMG to up to 3 targets in a 10m x 5m cone, knocks them down for 6 seconds, and slows their movement for 12 seconds.

Name: Force Sanctuary
Description: Creates a 4m sanctuary for 30 seconds. Allies inside gain regeneration equal to 2% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling every 3 seconds and take 5% less force damage.

Name: Force Spark
Description: Deals 30 force DMG plus WIL scaling to one target and reduces Evasion by 6% for 30 seconds.

Name: Fury Stance
Description: While active, gain +12% weapon and force damage and +15% critical damage, but take 5% more damage and suffer -5% Defense and Force Defense. Only one stance may be active.

Name: Guardian Ward
Description: Grants a single ally temporary HP equal to 15% of the target's maximum HP plus WIL scaling for 30 seconds.

Name: Hunger of the Dark
Description: For 45 seconds, Dark damage you deal heals you for 12% of damage dealt and defeated enemies restore 3 FP.

Name: Last Stand of the Light
Description: For 45 seconds, damage that would drop the target below 1 HP is prevented once and the target gains temporary HP equal to 15% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling.

Name: Mind Trick
Description: Attempts to inflict Confusion on the selected non-mechanical target and one non-mechanical target within 5m for 30 seconds. Caster Willpower increases duration, while target Willpower and Mind Resistance reduce it.

Name: Nightmare Field
Description: Enemies within 5m suffer -10% physical and Force ability Accuracy and -10% Evasion for 30 seconds.

Name: Purifying Wave
Description: Releases a 5m wave of focused light, dealing 22 force DMG plus WIL scaling to enemies and removing one minor negative effect (Bleed, Poison, or Hobble) from allies within 5m.

Name: Radiant Lance
Description: Fires a focused lance of radiant Force energy in an 8m x 2.5m line, dealing 44 force DMG plus WIL scaling to hostile targets in the line.

Name: Renewal
Description: Applies regeneration to a single ally, restoring 6% of maximum HP plus WIL scaling every 3 seconds for 30 seconds.

Name: Throw Lightsaber
Description: Hurls your equipped weapon with the Force through a 15m x 2.5m line, dealing weapon DMG + 30 physical DMG plus WIL/PER scaling to the selected target and up to two additional enemies in the line.

Name: Throw Rock
Description: Hurls a crushing mass of stone and debris with the Force up to 30m, dealing 60 physical DMG plus WIL/PER scaling to one target.

Name: Weaken Resolve
Description: Increases force damage taken by 10% for 24 seconds.

Name: Provoke
Description: Goads the selected target and all other enemies within 8m of it into attacking you. Enmity generated increases by 1% per VIT.

Name: Absolute Defense
Description: For 45 seconds, party members within 5m including you take 15% less physical and Force damage and are immune to Knockdown and Dazed.

Name: Bastion Stance
Description: While active, grants +20% to Enmity generation, +15% Defense, +15% Force Defense, -20% Attack, and -20% Force Attack.

Name: Blazing Spikes
Description: While active, this effect delivers 10% of physical damage received back to the attacker. Damage dealt increases by 1% per MGT. (Maximum 40%)

Name: Earthshatter
Description: You deal weapon DMG + 35 to all enemies in an 8m x 2.5m line from you. Inflicts Force Disruption on each target which disables the use of force abilities for 30 seconds and generates +350 Enmity.

Name: Flash
Description: Enemies within a 5m sphere around you receive Flash, reducing Ability Accuracy by 20% for 30 seconds (physical and Force abilities). Deals no damage. You generate +650 bonus Enmity toward these enemies.

Name: Fortress Strike
Description: Your next attack deals weapon DMG + 30 and generates +550 Enmity plus damage dealt as Enmity. You gain +30% Physical Defense for 30 seconds.

Name: Rampart
Description: All allies within a 5m sphere take 15% less physical damage for 1 minute.

Name: Sacrificial Blade
Description: Deal weapon DMG + 25 to a single target. Costs 8% max HP.

Name: Soul Burst
Description: Deal weapon DMG + 35 to all enemies in a 5m x 5m cone. Costs 40% HP which is reduced by 1% per MGT. (Minimum 10%)

Name: Soul Devourer
Description: While active, gain +25% Attack and +10% critical chance, but each attack you make deals 45% of the damage back to you. Damage reduced by 1% per MGT. (Minimum 20%)

Name: Soul Storm
Description: Sacrifice 40% HP to increase the damage of all allies within a 5m sphere by 20% for 1 minute. HP sacrificed decreases by 1 percentage point per MGT. (Minimum 10%)

Name: Soul Strike
Description: Your next attack deals +45 DMG and heals you for 30% of damage dealt. Amount healed increases by 1 percentage point per 2 MGT to a maximum of 40%.

Name: Adamantine Guard
Description: For 45 seconds, gain +25 Guard. Guarded hits reduce damage by an additional 20% and generate 75% more enmity.

Name: Guard Counter
Description: Queue your next auto attack to deal weapon DMG + 28. If you guarded an attack within the last 30 seconds, it deals weapon DMG + 45 instead and inflicts Dazed for 15 seconds.

Name: Hooking Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38 and inflicts Hamstring for 30 seconds.

Name: Interrupting Sweep
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m and interrupts current hostile actions when possible.

Name: Iron Wall Stance
Description: While active, grants +25% Defense, +20% Force Defense, and +30% Enmity generation, but reduces Attack by 25%.

Name: Joint Lock
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36. Inflicts Dazed for 15 seconds.

Name: Scrapheap Lockdown
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 25 to enemies within 5m of you. Enemies hit suffer Dazed and Hamstring for 30 seconds.

Name: Scrapper Stance
Description: While active, your control effects last +20% longer, but hostile ability cooldowns are increased by 10%.

Name: Steel Shoulder
Description: Target party ally becomes Guarded while you gain Guarding. While within 5 meters, the Guarded target gains Guard equal to 50% of your Guard. Only one ward or guard link may protect a target.

Name: Tag In
Description: Automatically targets your current Guarded ally if they are within 5 meters. Grants that target temporary HP equal to 15% of your maximum HP for 30 seconds and grants you +20 Guard for 30 seconds.

Name: Whirling Guard
Description: For 30 seconds, you gain +20 Guard. Whenever you guard a hit, deal 8 physical DMG to that attacker. Your current Guarded target automatically receives the same effect if they are within 5 meters when activated.

Name: Break Morale
Description: Enemies within Leadership range (5m base) suffer Flash, reducing Ability Accuracy by 15%, and Weakened, reducing Attack by 12%, for 30 seconds. SOC scaling can raise these penalties to 18% and 15%. This command applies reliably to valid enemies within Leadership range (5m base).

Name: Charge Order
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) gain +15% movement speed and +50 Mobility Resistance. SOC scaling can raise these to +18% movement speed and +65 Mobility Resistance.

Name: Cleanse Order
Description: Removes one major negative status effect from party members within Leadership range (5m base) and grants temporary HP equal to 12% of maximum HP for 30 seconds. SOC scaling can raise temporary HP to 15%.

Name: Coordinated Focus
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) gain +6% critical hit chance and +8% critical damage. SOC scaling can raise these to +7% and +10%.

Name: Decisive Command
Description: For 45 seconds, party members within Leadership range (5m base), including you, gain +12% damage, +6% physical and Force ability hit chance, +6% critical hit chance, and restore 1 STM every 3 seconds. SOC scaling can raise the bonuses to +15%, +8%, and +8%.

Name: Field Recovery
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) restore 2 STM every 4 seconds. SOC scaling can raise this to 3 STM per tick.

Name: Hold the Line
Description: For 45 seconds, party members within Leadership range (5m base), including you, gain temporary HP equal to 18% of maximum HP, take 18% less damage, and become immune to Mind and Mobility effects. SOC scaling can raise temporary HP and damage reduction to 22%.

Name: Press the Attack
Description: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) gain +10% damage and +5% physical and Force ability hit chance for 30 seconds. SOC scaling can raise these to +12% damage and +7% hit chance.

Name: Rallying Standard
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) gain +5% physical and Force ability hit chance. SOC scaling can raise this to +6%.

Name: Rousing Shout
Description: Bolsters one living ally, granting temporary HP equal to 20% of maximum HP for 30 seconds. SOC scaling can raise this to 25%. If the target is at or below 35% HP, they also take 20% less physical and Force damage, scaling up to 25%.

Name: Steady Formation
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) gain +5% evasion chance, +50 Mind Resistance, and +50 Mobility Resistance. SOC scaling can raise these to +6% evasion chance, +65 Mind Resistance, and +65 Mobility Resistance.

Name: Watchful Presence
Description: Aura: Party members within Leadership range (5m base) take 8% less physical and Force damage. SOC scaling can raise this to 10%.

Name: Aegis Eternal
Description: For 30 seconds, enter Perfect Aegis, replacing Saber Ward: convert 40% of incoming physical damage to Force damage and gain + 8% Defense, + 12% Force Defense, and + 25% Enmity. Embattled is treated as 5 stacks and Deflecting Return reflects 50% of damage, up to 125% of your normal weapon damage.

Name: Epicenter
Description: Inflicts Knockdown on enemies within 6m of you for 6 seconds, dealing 25 Force DMG and inflicting Sunder. Enemies that already had Sunder when struck take an additional 15 Force DMG.

Name: Force Link
Description: Target ally becomes your Link for 45 seconds. While within 20m, 45% of the Link's incoming damage is redirected to you as Force damage. Only one ward or guard link may protect a target.

Name: Force Sheath
Description: On your next hit, deal + 30 Force DMG.

Name: Guardian's Challenge
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 24 to enemies in an 8m x 3m line. For each struck enemy that damaged you within the last 30 seconds, gain +30% Enmity toward it for 30 seconds.

Name: Imbuement Stance
Description: While active, your hostile auto-attacks deal Force damage instead of physical and cost 2 FP each.

Name: Immovable Stance
Description: While active, generate + 30% Enmity and gain + 8 Mobility Resistance, but your Attack and Force Attack are reduced by 25%.

Name: Reprisal
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. If the target has damaged you within the last 30 seconds, inflict Dazed for 15 seconds.

Name: Saber Ward
Description: For 30 seconds, convert 30% of incoming physical damage to Force damage and gain + 6% Defense and + 9% Force Defense. Only the highest rank of Saber Ward applies.

Name: Shattering Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 28 and inflicts Sunder, reducing Defense and Force Defense by 12% for 30 seconds.

Name: Sundering Sweep
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 16 to enemies within 3m of you. If at least one struck enemy already has Sunder, spreads Sunder from that enemy to one other enemy in melee range for 30 seconds.

Name: Overclocked Analyzer
Description: Overclocks the combat analyzer, granting 2 additional technique slots and an activated ability that briefly boosts your equipped techniques' potency and on-hit effect chance.

Name: Dead Man's Hand
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. If this critically hits, your next three ranged attacks have +20% Critical Rate and no extra attack delay.

Name: Disarming Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38 and inflicts Disarming Shot for 30 seconds, reducing the target's Attack by 18%.

Name: Double Shot
Description: Fires twice for weapon DMG + 20 each. If either shot critically hits, restore 4 STM.

Name: Fan the Hammer
Description: Fires at up to 3 enemies within 5m for weapon DMG + 26. Each hit has +12% Critical Rate.

Name: Gambler Stance
Description: While active, gain +12% Critical Rate, but non-critical hostile ranged abilities cost 2 additional STM.

Name: Interrupting Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36. If the target is using an ability, also inflicts Disoriented for 30 seconds.

Name: Last Word
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 35. For 45 seconds, evading an attack refreshes Snap Roll and quickens your next shot.

Name: Point Blank Burst
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m and grants Point Blank Burst, providing +15% Evasion for 30 seconds.

Name: Quick Draw
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. Has +18% Critical Rate if used within 30 seconds after switching targets.

Name: Skirmisher Stance
Description: While active, grants +15% Evasion and +10% Movement Speed, but reduces Attack by 10%.

Name: Aimed Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. If you have not attacked for 3 seconds, this deals +26 DMG.

Name: Crippling Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and inflicts Hamstring for 30 seconds.

Name: Headshot
Description: Queues your next auto-attack to deal weapon DMG + 30. If Headshot is used after 3 seconds without attacking, that attack gains +25% Critical Rate.

Name: Kill Box
Description: Target an enemy or location to deal weapon DMG + 20 to enemies within 8m and apply Kill Box for 45 seconds. While Kill Box remains, any player's ranged attacks against affected enemies add Suppression stacks lasting 30 seconds using the Kill Box caster's Suppressing Shot stack strength; each stack reduces Evasion by an additional 3%.

Name: One Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 50. If used after 3 seconds without attacking, gains +25% Critical Rate and ignores 25% Defense.

Name: Piercing Round
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 in a 20m x 3m line and ignores 20% Defense.

Name: Sniper Stance
Description: While active, long-range hostile ranged abilities deal +15% damage, but attack delay is increased by 15%.

Name: Suppressing Shot
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. Grants a Suppression stack for 30 seconds. Your Suppression stacks reduce Evasion by 5% each.

Name: Suppression Stance
Description: While active, ranged attacks gain +10% Haste and add Suppression stacks lasting 30 seconds using your Suppressing Shot stack strength, but critical damage is reduced by 10%.

Name: Suppressive Line
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 in a 20m x 3m line. Targets hit by multiple Suppression stacks are Disoriented for 30 seconds.

Name: Circle Slash
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 to enemies within 5m and grants +8 Ranged Deflection for 30 seconds.

Name: Conduit Stance
Description: While active, Saberstaff abilities restore FP equal to 25% of STM spent and Force abilities restore STM equal to 25% of FP spent, but Attack and Force Attack are reduced by 10%.

Name: Double Strike
Description: Strikes twice for weapon DMG + 23 each. If both hits land, gain +5 FP.

Name: Focused Arc
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. If FP and STM are both above 60%, this deals +10 DMG.

Name: Guarded Channel
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and grants +20% Defense while both FP and STM are above 40%.

Name: Infinite Conduit
Description: For 45 seconds, Saberstaff abilities restore FP equal to 50% of STM spent and Force abilities restore STM equal to 50% of FP spent. When both resources are above 70%, hostile combat abilities also deal +20 DMG.

Name: Maelstrom Arc
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 in a 5m x 5m cone. If your Ranged Deflection negated a ranged weapon auto-attack in the last 30 seconds, restore 8 FP.

Name: Saber Cyclone
Description: For 45 seconds, area combat abilities restore 4 FP and grant +8 Ranged Deflection for 30 seconds.

Name: Sever Focus
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. If either FP or STM is above 80%, drains 8 of that resource from the target.

Name: Tempest Stance
Description: While active, area combat abilities gain +10% damage and +5 Ranged Deflection for 30 seconds, but single-target damage is reduced by 10%.

Name: Crippling Defense
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. For 45 seconds, your high-STM abilities also inflict Exposed for 30 seconds.

Name: Disabling Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. Inflicts Foggy Mind for 30 seconds, increasing ability costs.

Name: Disruption Field
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m of you and inflicts Force Disruption for 30 seconds.

Name: Forcebane
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 25 to enemies within 5m of you. Enemies hit suffer Foggy Mind, Force Disruption, and -20% Ability Accuracy for 45 seconds.

Name: Hampering Barrage
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 in a 5m x 5m cone and inflicts Hamstring for 30 seconds.

Name: Interruption Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36. If the target is using an ability, also drains 10 FP and STM.

Name: Perceptive Stance
Description: While active, hostile abilities you land drain 2 FP and 2 STM, but your Defense is reduced by 10%.

Name: Sweeping Flank
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 to enemies within 5m. If you are beside or behind a target, that target takes +24 DMG.

Name: Vigor Stance
Description: While active, all outgoing damage is increased by 10%. Using any hostile combat ability costs 2 additional STM and grants +8% Evasion for 30 seconds.

Name: Vigor Thrust
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38 and grants +12% Evasion for 30 seconds.

Name: Crusher Stance
Description: While active, deal +15% damage to enemies affected by control effects, but your attack delay is increased by 10%.

Name: Ground Quake
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m and knocks down already Dazed targets for 6 seconds.

Name: Leg Sweep
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and inflicts Knockdown for 6 seconds.

Name: Line Breaker
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38 in an 8m x 3m line and inflicts Disoriented for 30 seconds.

Name: Rib Breaker
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and inflicts Dazed for 15 seconds.

Name: Sentinel Stance
Description: While active, grants +15% Evasion and +8 Melee Deflection, but Attack is reduced by 15%.

Name: Shelter Circle
Description: For 30 seconds, you and allies within 5m gain +20% Physical Defense, +20% Force Defense, and +20% Evasion.

Name: Slam
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38. Targets affected by control effects take +26 DMG.

Name: Sweeping Guard
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 16 to enemies within 5m and grants +20% Defense for 30 seconds.

Name: Unmoving Center
Description: For 45 seconds, you cannot be Knocked down or Dazed, gain +20 Melee Deflection, and generate +30% Enmity.

Name: Worldbreaker
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 35 to enemies within 5m of you. Enemies affected by control effects take +40 DMG and are Dazed for 30 seconds.

Name: Concussive Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m of you and inflicts Dazed for 15 seconds.

Name: Explosive Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 32 to enemies in a 5m-radius area at the target location and inflicts Burn for 30 seconds.

Name: Flash Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and inflicts Blind for 15 seconds.

Name: Flurry Stance
Description: While active, thrown attacks against bleeding targets gain +10% Haste, but your Defense is reduced by 10%.

Name: Ordnance Stance
Description: While active, thrown area abilities deal +10% damage, but single-target thrown damage is reduced by 10%.

Name: Perfect Flurry
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. Bleeding targets take +45 DMG and spread Bleed to enemies within 5m for 45 seconds.

Name: Piercing Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 38 and inflicts Bleed for 60 seconds.

Name: Pinning Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 36 and inflicts Hamstring for 30 seconds. Bleeding targets also suffer Disoriented for 30 seconds.

Name: Rain of Steel
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 20 to enemies within 5m of you. For 45 seconds, thrown area abilities leave fragmentation zones that deal 8 physical DMG every 6 seconds.

Name: Severing Toss
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30. Bleeding targets suffer Hemorrhage for 30 seconds.

Name: Blade Vortex
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m. If this hits 3 or more enemies, restore 6 STM.

Name: Cross Cut
Description: Instantly attacks twice, each for weapon DMG + 27. If both attacks hit, gain a stack of Momentum for 30 seconds.

Name: Cyclone Stance
Description: While active, grants +15% Haste and +10% Attack, but reduces Defense by 20%.

Name: Lacerating Twin Cut
Description: Strikes twice for weapon DMG + 23 each and inflicts Bleed for 60 seconds.

Name: Lacerator Stance
Description: While active, your attacks against bleeding targets deal +10% damage, but your Evasion is reduced by 10%.

Name: Red Bloom
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 20 to enemies within 5m. Bleeding enemies take +40 DMG and spread Hemorrhage for 30 seconds.

Name: Serrated Arc
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 to enemies within 5m. Bleeding targets spread Bleed to one additional enemy within 5m.

Name: Spinning Whirl
Description: Attacks up to 3 enemies within 5m for weapon DMG + 30 each.

Name: Tempest Bloom
Description: Deal weapon DMG + 25 to enemies within 5m. For 45 seconds, each hostile area ability that lands creates one immediate pulse for 8 physical DMG to enemies within 5m of its first struck target.

Name: Twin Rupture
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 32. Bleeding targets suffer Hemorrhage for 30 seconds.

Name: Berserker Stance
Description: While active, grants +25% Attack, +15% Haste, -20% Defense, and -20% Force Defense.

Name: Covering Strike
Description: Strike all enemies within 5m for weapon DMG + 30. Enemies hit generate +25% Enmity toward you for 30 seconds.

Name: Defensive Stance
Description: While active, grants +30% Enmity generation, +20% Defense and +20% Force Defense, -20% Attack, and -20% Force Attack.

Name: Invincible
Description: For 45 seconds, you take 50% less physical damage and are immune to Knockdown and Dazed.

Name: Rending Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 32. Inflicts Exposed which reduces Defense by 15% for 30 seconds.

Name: Riot Blade
Description: On your next hit, deal weapon DMG + 25.

Name: Savage Cleave
Description: Deal weapon DMG + 20 in a 5m radius around you and restore 2 STM per secondary target hit.

Name: Shield Bash
Description: On your next hit, deal weapon DMG and an additional instance of damage equal to 10% of your Physical Defense.

Name: Shield Wall
Description: Channel for up to 30 seconds. While channeling you and any allies within 5m gain 35% damage reduction.

Name: Assassin's Stance
Description: While active, grants +20% Poison Damage, but reduces Attack by 10%.

Name: Backstab
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 25. If you are behind your target, deal an additional +20 DMG and inflict Knockdown for 6 seconds.

Name: Crippling Slice
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 28 and inflicts Exposed for 30 seconds.

Name: Escape Artist
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 and Blinds the target for 12 seconds and grants Invisibility for 30 seconds.

Name: Pathogen Strike
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 19. Extends your Venom and Infection effects on the target by 6 seconds.

Name: Shadowflow Stance
Description: While active, your Vibroknife auto-attacks inflict Hamstring for 18 seconds, but your Defense is reduced by 20%.

Name: Veiled Strike
Description: On your next attack, deal +16 DMG and an additional +12 DMG if the target is inflicted with Exposed.

Name: Viral Cascade
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30, deals an additional +20 DMG if the target is inflicted with your Venom and +8 DMG per stack of your Infection on the target. Consumes your Venom and Infection stacks from the target.

Name: Virulent Blade
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 16. Inflicts Venom for 30 seconds.

Name: Volatile Compound
Description: Deals weapon DMG + 30 and inflicts -25 Poison Resistance for 30 seconds.
